page.notes: The woodcut vignette shows a figure within an oval border with the mottoes "SPERA VOTIS", "AXIMIANTE" (partly illegible), "DEO CEDIT", "SORS PRO". The year on the right is printed as "1613" in spaced numerals. Some letters at the left edge of the first lines are cut off by the scan (e.g. "VVLNERVM" line and "NE" line begin with a partly visible letter); the leading letters "M", "V" and "I" at the left margin are damaged. "RODOLPH." is partly obscured and read from context; "ANNO" partly cut off at the left edge.
